parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
{{Map|zoom=0|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Various locations the player visits during the quest. The blue pin indicates the quest start location.
|1313,3469,icon:bluePin,desc:Quest start
|1364,3637,desc:Molch Island|1314,3617,desc:Xeric's Shrine|1450,3511,desc:Ruins of Morra}}
{{Checklist|
* Start the quest by searching the tent for [[Kasonde's journal]] ([[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]] with code {{fairycode|BLS}} and head south east). {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
* Read the journal.
* Search the camping equipment to receive [[secateurs]].
* Climb down the nearby hole.
* Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the first [[Stone tablet (The Garden of Death)|stone tablet]].
[[File:The Garden of Death - campsite dungeon searchable objects.png|thumb|center|500px|The locations of searchable objects in the dungeon south east of Mount Quidamortem.]]
* Read the stone tablet and take the note to receive the [[word translations]] scroll. {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
* Read the word translations scroll and click "Attempt Translation". Input the following words and press enter for each: Island, Water, Time, Vessel, North.
* Climb-up the rope to exit the hole.
* Travel to [[Lake Molch]] via [[Boaty]] and select [[Molch Island]]. (Fairy ring with code {{fairycode|DJR}} and head west.) {{Chat option|1Molch Island}}
* Enter the hole on Molch Island.
* Inspect the vines for a [[dirty note]].
* Cut the vines with your secateurs and squeeze through them.
* Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the second [[Stone tablet (The Garden of Death)|stone tablet]].
[[File:The Garden of Death - Lake Molch Island searchable objects.png|thumb|center|500px|The locations of searchable objects in the dungeon beneath Lake Molch Island.]]
* Read the stone tablet, then input the following words on the word translations scroll: West, Poison, Body, Food, Earth.
* Climb-up the rope to exit the hole.
* Travel to [[Xeric's Shrine]].
** Board [[Boaty]] and select [[Molch]]. {{Chat option|1Molch}}
** Run west and then south to the altar.
* Enter the hole at Xeric's Shrine.
* Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the third [[Stone tablet (The Garden of Death)|stone tablet]].
[[File:The Garden of Death - Xeric's Shrine searchable objects.png|thumb|center|500px|The locations of searchable objects in the dungeon beneath Kebos Swamp.]]
* Read the stone tablet, then input the following words on the word translations scroll: Make, Yes, No, Move, Arrive, East, South.
* Make your way to the [[Ruins of Morra]]. Enter the hole there.
** Board [[Boaty]] and select [[Shayzien]]. {{Chat option|3Shayzien}}
** Run south to the ruins.
* Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the final [[Stone tablet (The Garden of Death)|stone tablet]].
[[File:The Garden of Death - Ruins of Morra searchable objects.png|thumb|center|500px|The locations of searchable objects in the dungeon beneath the Ruins of Morra.]]
* Read the stone tablet, then input the following words on the word translations scroll: Few, Big, Sun, Moon, Life, Death, Mind, Home, Air, Fire.
* Read the stone tablet again and then read the [[warning note]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
